protocol.randomization: full-strength Phase 3 domain randomization and moving-person distribution
protocol.note: The Phase 3L reference and Phase 3M hybrid are an architecture progression, not a single-variable ablation: Phase 3M also restores the declared low-friction caster contact class and adds bounded recovery supervision.

selected_candidate.runtime_architecture: trained recurrent brake/steering residual plus hash-locked route actor, clearance projection, front-LiDAR stop, bounded office-pivot primitive, predictive creep and a timed 6/18 Nm actuator gate

decision.reason: The candidate fixes the targeted office departures and segment-6 turn and strongly improves route completion. Dynamic-obstacle results remain seed-sensitive, the independent seed falls below the 90 percent success threshold, and neither run satisfies the declared 64-episodes-per-segment protocol.

next_gate: train and validate a 360-degree dynamic-obstacle safety layer without changing the successful office-pivot geometry; then run 64 episodes per segment, the Phase 2 static regression, and 12 live-administration dynamic scenarios
claim_boundary: Simulation architecture-selection evidence only. This is not human-safety certification, full Phase 3 acceptance, sim-to-real validation, or permission for physical deployment.
